_doc: Mod-level profile for go/no-go. feel: tech, magic, alchemy, nature, breeding, steampunk, sci-fi, survival, neutral (two or more = hybrid). add: the mod's main contribution (resources, power, tooling, armor, storage, processing, automation, combat, content, food, building, integration, qol, library). fit: per pack, [good|partial|poor, reason]. status: pending until decided after the deep review.
